connections.why: Recording from sources feeds the investigation that develops ideas
Developed ideas are then refined through media experimentation
Refinement leads to a resolved, personal final response
Observational recording informs choices of media and process
Investigation and intentions are realised in the final outcome
Portfolio skills transfer directly into the set-assignment preparation
Preparatory work culminates in the supervised final outcome
The same develop-ideas skills are reapplied to the externally set theme
The chosen title determines which media and processes are explored
The endorsement shapes the artists and contexts investigated
The title defines the discipline of the final realised response
Photography is itself a recording discipline feeding the AOs
Textile processes are the media refined within that endorsement
3D design culminates in a constructed final outcome
